stato: Proposta da mostrare prima dell'inserimento nel booklet
destinazione_prevista: Capitolo 01, pagina stampata 3, N iniziale di «Nel Medioevo»
consultazione_riferimento: Ricerca Google Immagini consultata nel browser: iniziali istoriate con miniature narrative. Generazione originale senza importare immagini di terzi nel modello.
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: a single historiated illuminated initial for the N in the Italian sentence "Nel Medioevo", in a printed visual communication and interface design course booklet. This is a preview proposal, not a page mockup.
Primary request: Create an original medieval manuscript HISTORIATED CAPITAL N, with a miniature scene of a medieval school integrated into the initial. The classroom scene is essential and clearly visible, not just floral ornament.
Subject and composition: One clearly legible Latin uppercase N, formed by two upright stems and the diagonal from upper left to lower right. The letter's broad illuminated strokes frame a coherent little schoolroom in its two triangular counters: a seated master teaching three young adult pupils at wooden writing desks. The teacher indicates a parchment page with drawn letterforms and a simple ruled composition; pupils arrange letterforms on ruled parchment, sketch with quills and paint with small pigment shells. An open codex, a straightedge and dividers on the desk subtly evoke typography, color, grids and visual composition. Keep the action readable and the figures large enough; avoid excessive tiny objects. The diagonal N stroke runs naturally through the composition, visibly joining its vertical stems; the figures remain readable around it.
Style/medium: Authentic-looking late medieval Italian manuscript illumination, hand-painted opaque tempera and restrained flat burnished gold on vellum, fine ink contours, simplified delicate faces, medieval schematic shallow perspective, luminous ultramarine, muted vermilion, rose and soft green. Visible fine brushwork and light irregularities of hand painting. The scene and letter must feel like one manuscript miniature, not a modern illustration pasted into a letter. Modest acanthus and ivy extensions integrated at the corners. A contemporary original historical-style illustration.
Scene/backdrop: Suggest the school with one Gothic arch, a stone wall and wooden benches, only inside the miniature. Genuine alpha transparency outside the irregular outer silhouette of the illuminated initial and its close ornamental extensions. No parchment sheet or page background outside the artwork.
Text (verbatim): "N"
Constraints: EXACTLY ONE recognizable N. No surrounding words, inscriptions, pseudo-writing, titles or captions. Pages inside the scene may have simple ruled marks and geometric arrangements, not legible extra text. Compact near-square composition filling the image with a small clear margin, all ornaments fully in frame. Make the miniature scene prominent while retaining the N as the organizing structure.
Avoid: a standalone decorative N without a narrative scene; a separate rectangular picture frame; photorealism, 3D rendering, embossed metal, glossy gradients, Baroque lettering, modern classrooms, screens, laptops, electronics, logos, watermarks, drop shadows, a book photographed on a table, and a simulated checkerboard background. Preserve real transparency.
